title: Every maximal ideal of a polynomial ring over a field has height the number of variables
statement: Let k be a field, n a natural number, and M a maximal ideal of the polynomial ring k[X₁, …, X_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Then the height of M is n.

proof.text: Apply the proved upstream theorem MvPolynomial.height_eq_of_isMaximal. Its proof inducts on n: at zero the ring has dimension zero; at the successor use finSuccEquiv, contract the maximal ideal to the Jacobson coefficient ring, and apply Polynomial.height_eq_height_add_one.
